visualCharacteristics.purpose: Intro copy with CTAs beside a stack of large statistic figures

usage: Company-credentials section showing key figures next to an intro and CTAs.
reuseGuidance: Use when a copy block sits beside two to four headline numbers. Author each value in bold on its own paragraph, label in the next paragraph.
